User story: As an owner, I want the app installed on my computer with automated tests on every push, so that I know each change works before it goes further.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a fresh clone of the repo, when a commit is pushed to main, then GitHub Actions installs ERPNext v16 and construction_core on a new site and all tests pass.
2. Given a failing test, when a commit is pushed, then the CI run is red and the commit is marked failed.

User story: As any user, I want to open the portal at /portal in Arabic, so that the app feels native to me.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given I am logged in, when I open /portal, then I see "أهلاً، <my full name>" in a right-to-left layout.
2. Given I am logged out, when I open /portal, then I am redirected to /login and back to /portal after logging in.

User story: As an owner, I want a versions and licenses report, so that I know exactly what the product depends on.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given phase 0 is complete, when I open docs/versions.md, then it lists frappe, erpnext, frappe_docker and frappe-ui with exact version, license and release date.

User story: As an engineer, I want to see only the projects I am assigned to, so that client data stays private between teams.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given I am not in a project's team (Project User), when I open that project by URL or API, then I get a permission error.
2. Given I am not in a project's team, when I list projects, then that project is not in the list.

User story: As a client, I want to see only my own projects and never internal notes, so that I see what concerns me and nothing confidential.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given another client's project, when I request it by ID, then I get a permission error.
2. Given an update marked internal only on my project, when I list or open updates, then that update and its photos are not returned.

User story: As an admin, I want project progress calculated from weighted stages, so that the percentage reflects real work, not a simple average.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given stage A weight 5 is Done and stage B weight 30 is at 50%, others at 0, when progress is recalculated, then the project shows 20.0%.
2. Given an Auto stage with 4 checklist items, 3 ticked, when the stage is saved, then its progress is 75%.
3. Given stage weights that add up to 90, when I open the project, then I see a warning that weights do not total 100.

User story: As an admin, I want a new project to copy the stages of a template, so that I do not re-type stages for every project.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a template with 8 stages and checklists, when I create a project from it, then the project has 8 stages with the same names, weights and checklists.
2. Given a project created from a template, when I later edit the template, then the existing project's stages do not change.

User story: As an admin, I want office name, logo, colors and terms stored in one settings page, so that the product can serve other offices later (SaaS).
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given Inceptiondesign Settings has a logo and office name, when any page, email or PDF is rendered, then it uses those values.
2. Given the codebase, when the hardcoded-branding test runs, then it fails if the office name appears literally in templates or Python.

User story: As a client, I want an approval I answered to be locked, so that nobody can change what I agreed to.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given an approval I answered, when anyone, including the admin, tries to edit it, then the change is rejected.

User story: As an admin, I want to arrange a project's stages, weights and dates in one screen, so that setting up a project takes minutes.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a project, when I add, reorder or edit stages in the Stages section, then the changes save and the weight total updates.
2. Given a new admin with a template, when they create a project, add a client and publish it, then it takes under 3 minutes.

User story: As an admin, I want to add a client who has an email, so that they can log in without me managing passwords.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given the Add Client dialog with name, Egyptian mobile and email, when I confirm, then a Customer, Contact and portal User are created, linked to the project, and a welcome email with a set-password link is sent.
2. Given a mobile number not matching 01[0125]XXXXXXXX, when I confirm, then I see a validation error.

User story: As an admin, I want to add a client who has no email, using a username and a WhatsApp message, so that clients without email can still use the portal.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given the Add Client dialog without email, when I enter a username and confirm, then a 12-character temporary password is shown once, and a WhatsApp button opens wa.me with the login details.

User story: As a client, I want to be forced to change a temporary password on first login, so that only I know my password.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given my account has a temporary password, when I log in, then I only see the change-password page until I change it.
2. Given I changed my password, when I open /portal, then I reach the portal normally.

User story: As an admin, I want to add engineers to a project, so that they can work on it from the portal.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a user with the Construction Engineer role, when I add them with Add Engineer, then they appear in the project team and see it in /portal.

User story: As an admin, I want to publish a project by secret link and revoke it, so that I can share progress safely with prospects.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a project set to visibility = link, when I press New Link, then a new link is shown once and the old link returns 404.
2. Given a link with an expiry date in the past, when a visitor opens it, then they get 404.

User story: As the office, I want nobody to create an account by signing in with Google or Facebook, so that only clients I added can enter.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given signup is disabled and an email that is not registered, when someone signs in with Google using it, then no user is created and they see "الحساب ده مش مسجّل، كلّم المكتب".

User story: As an engineer, I want a list of my projects with progress and current stage, so that I know where to go today.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given I am assigned to 3 projects, when I open /portal, then I see 3 cards with name, progress bar, current stage and last update date.

User story: As an engineer, I want to post a stage update with photos from my phone, so that the office and client see progress without calls.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given I select 10 photos of 4 MB each on a slow connection, when I submit the update, then every photo uploads with a progress bar and is stored under 500 KB.
2. Given an uploaded photo, when its metadata is inspected, then it contains no GPS location.
3. Given a photo fails to upload 3 times, when the upload stops, then the update shows that photo as failed with a retry button.

User story: As an engineer, I want to tick checklist items on a stage, so that progress updates itself.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given an Auto-mode stage, when I tick an item, then the stage and project progress update.

User story: As an engineer, I want to mark an update as internal only, so that I can record problems the client should not see.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given an update marked internal only, when the client opens their portal, then the update and its photos are not shown.

User story: As an engineer, I want to mark good photos as suitable for publishing, so that the office can use them in public pages.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a photo, when I toggle مناسبة للنشر, then it becomes available to public pages through a separate public copy.

User story: As an engineer, I want clear limits on videos, so that uploads do not fail silently.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a video longer than 60 s or bigger than 50 MB, when I pick it, then I see an Arabic message explaining the limit and it is not uploaded.

User story: As an engineer, I want to install the portal on my phone's home screen, so that it opens like an app.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given Android Chrome, when I choose Install app, then the portal installs and opens full screen with its icon.

User story: As a client, I want a home screen with progress, current stage, latest updates and next payment, so that I understand my project at a glance.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given my project, when I open /portal, then I see overall progress, current stage, the last 3 non-internal updates and the next payment amount.

User story: As a client, I want a timeline of stages with planned and actual dates, so that I know if the project is late.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a stage that finished 4 days after its planned end, when I open the timeline, then it shows a 4-day delay.

User story: As a client, I want a gallery of site photos grouped by stage and date, so that I can follow the work visually.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given photos on several stages, when I open the gallery and filter by a stage, then I see only that stage's photos, newest first, with a lightbox.

User story: As a client, I want to see my payments and download invoices in Arabic, so that I know what I owe and have records.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a milestone with a submitted invoice, when I open Payments, then I see its status and can download an Arabic RTL PDF invoice.

User story: As a client, I want to chat with my engineer with photos, so that questions are answered in one place.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given the engineer and I both have the chat open, when I send a message, then the engineer sees it within 5 seconds.
2. Given another client's project ID, when I try to send or read messages there, then the request is rejected.

User story: As an engineer, I want to ask the client for an approval in the chat, so that decisions are recorded.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given I send an approval request with title, details and amount, when the client presses موافق or عندي سؤال, then the answer and time are shown and can no longer change.

User story: As a client, I want notifications for updates, finished stages, messages, approvals and due payments, so that I never miss anything.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a new non-internal update, when it is saved, then I get an email and an in-portal notification.
2. Given an internal update, when it is saved, then I get no notification.

User story: As a visitor, I want to browse apartment designs with filters, so that I find a design that fits my apartment.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given published designs, when I filter by area, bedrooms, style and price and sort, then only matching designs show, 12 per page.
2. Given an unpublished design, when I open its URL, then I get 404.

User story: As a visitor, I want a design page with images, floor plan, stages, duration and estimated cost, so that I understand what I would get.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a published design, when I open it, then I see its gallery, floor plan, execution stages, duration and cost range.

User story: As a visitor, I want to request implementation of a design, so that the office contacts me.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given the request form with valid name, Egyptian mobile, governorate and area, when I submit, then a Lead linked to the design is created and the admin is emailed.
2. Given 5 requests from my IP in the last hour, when I submit a 6th, then it is rejected with a friendly message.

User story: As a visitor, I want to view a published project, so that I trust the office's work.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a public project with photos set to publishable only, when I open it, then I see only publishable photos and no phone, email, amounts or client name unless allowed.
2. Given a private project, when I open its slug, then I get the same 404 as for a missing project.

User story: As a visitor, I want privacy and data-deletion pages in Arabic, so that I know how my data is used.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given the public site, when I open /privacy or /data-deletion, then I see the current Arabic text with contact details from Settings.

User story: As an admin, I want to remove demo content with one command before launch, so that no sample data reaches real clients.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given the demo design is installed, when I run the demo removal command, then the demo design and its files are gone.

User story: As an accountant, I want to invoice a due milestone in one click, so that billing follows progress.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a milestone that became Due, when I press اعمل فاتورة, then a draft Sales Invoice for the customer, project and amount is created.
2. Given I submit that invoice, when it is submitted, then the milestone becomes Invoiced and links the invoice.

User story: As an accountant, I want collections to mark milestones as paid, so that the client portal is always accurate.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given an invoiced milestone, when I submit a Payment Entry that fully pays the invoice, then the milestone becomes Paid and the client sees Paid.
2. Given that Payment Entry, when I cancel it, then the milestone returns to Invoiced.

User story: As an accountant, I want to record site expenses by project and stage, so that I see where money goes.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a Purchase Invoice with project and stage, when I submit it, then its cost appears under that project and stage in reports.

User story: As an accountant, I want VAT applied from a template I control, so that tax is correct without code changes.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a VAT template with the rate I entered, when I apply it to an invoice, then tax is calculated at that rate.

User story: As an owner, I want a financial summary per project, so that I know contract value, billed, collected, spent and outstanding.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a sample project with invoices, payments and expenses, when I run the report, then its totals equal the General Ledger and Receivables to the piastre.

User story: As a salesperson, I want a Kanban pipeline of opportunities, so that no lead is forgotten.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a Lead from the website, when I convert it, then an Opportunity appears in جديد on the Kanban.
2. Given an opportunity, when I drag it to تسعير, then its stage is saved and the change is logged.

User story: As an estimator, I want a price library with dated prices and their source, so that estimates use real, traceable prices.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a material with prices dated January and March, when I estimate on a date in February, then the January price is used.
2. Given a price record, when anyone tries to delete it, then it is kept; only a new dated price can supersede it.

User story: As an estimator, I want reusable assemblies (e.g. one square metre of floor tiling, all-in), so that I estimate fast and consistently.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given an assembly with tile, adhesive, grout and labor lines with waste %, when I use it for 50 m², then each component quantity and cost is calculated correctly.

User story: As an estimator, I want an estimate builder with sections and a live total, so that I produce quotes quickly.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given an estimate with material, labor, overhead 10%, profit 15% and VAT, when I save it, then the total equals the engine's known test result to the piastre.

User story: As an estimator, I want revisions with a comparison, so that changes are traceable.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given an approved estimate, when I press Revise, then revision 2 is created and revision 1 is marked Superseded and cannot change.
2. Given two revisions, when I compare them, then added, removed and changed lines are listed with the money difference.

User story: As a salesperson, I want to turn an approved estimate into a Quotation, so that the client receives a formal offer.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given an approved estimate, when I press Create Quotation, then an ERPNext Quotation with one line per section is created and linked.

User story: As an estimator, I want to import prices from Excel, so that I update the library in bulk.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a filled price template, when I import it, then new dated prices are created and errors are reported per row.

User story: As an admin, I want to send a proposal or contract for e-signature, so that the client can sign without visiting.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given an approved quotation and a contract template, when I press ابعت للتوقيع, then an Arabic PDF is stored privately with its hash and the client is notified by email and portal.

User story: As a client, I want to sign on my phone with a code, so that signing is quick and secure.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a signature request, when I read it, request the code, enter it and draw my signature, then the request becomes Signed and every step is logged with time and IP.
2. Given I enter a wrong code 3 times, when I try a 4th time, then the request is locked until the office resends it.

User story: As an owner, I want signed documents frozen and verifiable, so that they hold up in a dispute.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a signed request, when anyone tries to change it or its file, then the change is rejected.
2. Given the stored PDF is altered, when I run Verify, then it reports the hash does not match.

User story: As an admin, I want signing a contract to set up the project automatically, so that no double data entry.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a contract is signed, when the kickoff runs, then the project, stages with weights, tasks and payment milestones exist and the client is on the project.

User story: As a client, I want to decline with a reason, so that the office knows what to change.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a signature request, when I press Decline and enter a reason, then the admin is notified with the reason.

User story: As an admin, I want requests to expire, so that old offers are not signed by mistake.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a request past its expiry date, when the daily job runs, then it becomes Expired and cannot be signed.

User story: As the office, I want a catalog of finish options with photos and prices, so that clients choose from what we can supply.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a category with options linked to items, when I view an option, then it shows photos, brand, origin and the current price from the library.

User story: As an engineer, I want to assign selections to a project with an allowance and a due date, so that choices are made on time and in budget.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a project, when I add a selection for floor tiles in the reception, 40 m², allowance 20,000 EGP, due in 10 days, then the client sees it in اختياراتي.

User story: As a client, I want to see the price effect of each option before choosing, so that I decide with full information.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given an allowance of 500 EGP/m² and an option at 650 EGP/m² for 40 m², when I view the option, then it shows + 6,000 EGP.
2. Given an option within the allowance, when I view it, then it shows ضمن الميزانية.

User story: As a client, I want to approve my choices, so that the office can order materials.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a choice over the allowance, when I approve, then I am asked to sign, and after signing a draft change order with the difference is created.
2. Given an approved selection, when I or the engineer try to change it, then it is locked.

User story: As a procurement, I want a purchase list from approved selections, so that we order the right items on time.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given approved and unapproved selections, when I run the purchase list, then only approved ones show with item, quantity and date needed.

User story: As a client, I want reminders before selection due dates, so that I do not delay the work.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a selection due in 3 days, when the daily job runs, then I get a reminder; on the due date I get another.

User story: As an admin, I want to unlock a selection with a reason, so that mistakes can be corrected with a record.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a locked selection, when I unlock it with a reason, then a new revision is created and the reason is logged.

User story: As a client, I want to request a change from the portal with photos, so that my request is recorded and priced.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given my project, when I submit اطلب تعديل with a description and 2 photos, then a Draft change order is created and the engineer and admin are notified.

User story: As an engineer, I want to create a change order on site, so that issues found on site are captured immediately.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given the portal on my phone, when I create a change order with photos, then a Draft appears for pricing in the office.

User story: As an estimator, I want change orders priced by the costing engine, so that prices are consistent and traceable.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given change order lines including a removal, when I save, then the cost difference is calculated by the engine and cannot be typed by hand.

User story: As a client, I want to review and sign change orders, so that nothing changes my price without my consent.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a change order sent to me, when I sign it, then it becomes Approved, and a payment milestone for the difference is created.
2. Given a change order sent to me, when I reject it with a reason, then it becomes Rejected and keeps its history.

User story: As an accountant, I want negative change orders to produce a credit, so that the client is billed correctly.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given an approved change order of -3,000 EGP, when it is processed, then a credit is created and the receivables report shows it.

User story: As an owner, I want approved changes to update budget and schedule, so that plans stay realistic.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given an approved change order with +5 days impact, when it is approved, then the project budget increases by the difference and dependent stages move 5 working days.

User story: As an engineer, I want a Gantt chart of project tasks with dependencies, so that I plan and adjust visually.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a project with tasks, when I drag a task to new dates, then the dates save and the parent stage's planned dates update.

User story: As an admin, I want a company calendar of crew and subcontractor assignments, so that I see who is where.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given assignments across projects, when I open the calendar and filter by crew, then I see that crew's assignments in day, week or month view.

User story: As an admin, I want warnings when a crew is double-booked, so that I avoid idle sites and angry clients.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a crew assigned to project A on days 1-5, when I assign it to project B on day 3, then I see a warning naming project A; if I override, it is logged.

User story: As an engineer, I want to delay a task and move everything that depends on it, so that the schedule stays consistent.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a chain of 3 dependent tasks and a Friday in between, when I postpone the first by 2 working days, then the preview and saved dates skip Fridays and holidays, and the client and foremen are notified.

User story: As a foreman, I want to see my crew's work for today and this week, so that I know where to take the team.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given I am a foreman, when I open شغلي النهارده, then I see only my crew's assignments with address and map link.

User story: As an admin, I want Fridays and Egyptian public holidays in the calendar, so that dates are realistic.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given the holiday list for the year, when dates are calculated, then holidays are skipped as non-working days.

User story: As an engineer, I want a daily log of manpower, work done, materials, issues and photos, so that every site day is documented.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given today's log already exists for the project, when I open the daily log, then I edit the same log, prefilled from yesterday where useful.

User story: As a foreman, I want to clock my crew in and out with location, so that hours are trusted without paper.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given I accepted the Arabic consent notice, when I clock in within 150 m of the site, then a clock event is saved as inside the site area.
2. Given I am 400 m away, when I clock in, then the event is saved and flagged for engineer approval.
3. Given I have not accepted consent, when I try to clock in, then I am shown the consent notice first and nothing is recorded.

User story: As an accountant, I want timesheets built from clock events and costed, so that labor cost lands on the project.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given matched in and out events, when the nightly job runs and the engineer submits, then a Timesheet is created and the project's labor cost rises by hours × rate.
2. Given an In without an Out, when the job runs, then it is flagged and not counted.

User story: As a client, I want to see daily logs of my project without costs, so that I see work happening every day.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a non-internal daily log, when I open it, then I see work done and photos but no manpower costs.

User story: As a client, I want a weekly summary PDF, so that I get a simple progress report.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a week of logs, when the weekly job runs, then I receive an Arabic PDF with days worked, progress and photos.

User story: As a procurement, I want material requests generated from approved selections and estimates, so that purchasing starts from real needs.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given approved selections and estimate lines, when I generate requests, then Material Requests per project and stage with needed-by dates are created.

User story: As a procurement, I want to compare supplier quotations, so that I buy at the best price.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given an RFQ sent to 3 suppliers with their quotations entered, when I open the comparison, then I see prices side by side and can create a PO from the chosen one.

User story: As a procurement, I want purchase orders linked to project and stage, so that committed costs are visible.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a PO with project and stage, when it is submitted, then the committed cost report includes it under that project and stage.

User story: As an engineer, I want to confirm deliveries on site with a photo, so that we pay only for what arrived.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a PO delivered to site, when I confirm receipt with a photo of the delivery note, then a Purchase Receipt is created with the photo attached.

User story: As an admin, I want signed subcontracts with retention and advance, so that terms are clear and enforceable.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a subcontract with lines, 10% retention and an advance, when it is signed, then it becomes active and cannot be edited.

User story: As an engineer, I want subcontractor progress claims (مستخلصات) with automatic previous quantities, so that claims are fast and correct.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given 3 consecutive claims with retention and advance recovery, when each is approved, then net due matches the hand calculation and a Purchase Invoice is created.
2. Given a claim exceeding contract quantity, when I submit without admin override, then it is blocked.

User story: As an accountant, I want to release retention at project end, so that subcontractors are paid what is held.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given retention held on approved claims, when I release it, then a payment is created and retention payable in the ledger becomes zero.

User story: As an engineer, I want a document library per project with versions, so that everyone uses the current drawing.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a drawing with version 1, when I upload version 2, then version 2 becomes current and version 1 stays downloadable.

User story: As a client, I want to see the documents the office shares with me, so that I have my contract and drawings at hand.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given documents marked visible and not visible, when I open Documents, then I see only visible ones at their current version.
2. Given a non-visible document's URL, when I open it, then access is denied.

User story: As an engineer, I want to draw and write on photos and plans, so that I explain issues clearly.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a site photo, when I add arrows and Arabic text and save, then a marked-up copy is saved, editable later, and the original is unchanged.

User story: As an estimator, I want to measure lengths and areas on a drawing, so that quantities come from the plan.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a PDF floor plan, when I calibrate a known 5 m wall and draw a 4×5 m room, then the measured area is 20 m².
2. Given a measured area, when I press أضف للتسعير, then it becomes the quantity of an estimate line.

User story: As a client, I want to pay a due payment online by card or mobile wallet, so that I pay without visiting the office.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a due milestone and the gateway sandbox, when I press ادفع دلوقتي and complete payment, then a Payment Entry is created automatically and the milestone shows Paid.

User story: As an accountant, I want gateway notifications verified and never duplicated, so that the books are accurate.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a webhook with an invalid signature, when it arrives, then it is rejected and logged.
2. Given the same successful webhook twice, when both arrive, then only one Payment Entry exists.
3. Given a missed webhook, when the 15-minute check runs, then the payment is reconciled.

User story: As a client, I want to upload a bank transfer or InstaPay receipt, so that I can pay without card fees.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a due milestone, when I upload a transfer receipt, then the accountant is notified and confirming it creates the Payment Entry.

User story: As a client, I want an Arabic receipt for every payment, so that I have proof of payment.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a confirmed payment, when it is recorded, then I receive an Arabic PDF receipt by email and in the portal.

User story: As a client, I want polite reminders before and after due dates, so that I pay on time.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a milestone due on day 10, when 30 days are simulated, then I get reminders on days 7, 10, 17 and 24 and no others.

User story: As an accounts manager, I want to refund a payment with an audit note, so that mistakes are fixed properly.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a gateway payment, when I refund it as Accounts Manager, then the gateway refund is requested and a reversing entry with my note is created.
2. Given a user without Accounts Manager, when they try to refund, then the action is not available.

User story: As an engineer, I want to record updates, logs and photos without signal, so that weak coverage on site does not stop me.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given I am offline, when I create an update with 3 photos and tick an item, then they are queued and sent exactly once when I am back online.
2. Given the browser is closed mid-sync, when I reopen it, then syncing resumes without duplicates.

User story: As an engineer, I want to read my projects and today's tasks offline, so that I have what I need on site.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given I opened the portal online earlier, when I open it offline, then I see cached projects and assignments with the last update time.

User story: As an engineer, I want to see what is still waiting to sync, so that I trust nothing is lost.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given 2 items in the queue, when I open the sync panel, then I see both with status and can retry a failed one.

User story: As any user, I want push notifications on my phone, so that I react quickly.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given I enabled notifications on Android, when someone sends me a message, then I get a push notification that opens the chat.

User story: As any user, I want to mute notification categories, so that I only get what matters to me.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given I muted payment reminders, when a reminder is due, then no push is sent to me for it.

User story: As an engineer, I want an option to upload photos on Wi-Fi only, so that I save mobile data.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given Wi-Fi only is on and I am on mobile data, when I add photos, then they wait in the queue until I am on Wi-Fi.

User story: As an owner, I want a WIP report with earned value and over/under billing, so that I know which projects make or lose money.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a seeded project with known numbers, when I run WIP, then earned value, billed to date and over/under billing match the expected values.

User story: As an owner, I want job costing by stage: budget, committed, actual, so that I spot overruns early.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given POs, subcontracts and invoices on a project, when I run job costing, then committed and actual match the source documents and ERPNext reports.

User story: As an owner, I want a labor report by project, crew and employee, so that I control labor cost.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given timesheets and flagged clock events, when I run the labor report, then hours, cost and out-of-area flags are shown per project and crew.

User story: As a salesperson, I want pipeline and conversion reports, so that I improve how we win work.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given opportunities across stages and outcomes, when I run the pipeline report, then I see counts per stage, conversion rate, win/loss reasons and lead source.

User story: As an owner, I want a manager dashboard with key numbers, so that I see the business on one page.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given live data, when I open لوحة المدير, then I see active projects, WIP, receivables, overdue, late projects and pipeline value, each drilling down to its source.

User story: As an engineer, I want my own dashboard in the portal, so that I know my priorities.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given I am an engineer, when I open my dashboard, then I see only my projects, today's tasks, overdue selections and pending approvals.

User story: As an owner, I want a weekly summary by email, so that I stay informed without logging in.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given Saturday 9 AM, when the scheduler runs, then I receive a PDF summary.
2. Given 200 seeded projects, when any report runs, then it finishes in under 3 seconds.

User story: As an engineer, I want to ask the assistant in Arabic to draft a change order, so that pricing a change takes seconds.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given "عايز أغيّر سيراميك الريسبشن لباركيه" on my project, when I send it, then a Draft change order is created whose numbers equal the costing engine's output.

User story: As an owner, I want a monthly AI spending cap, so that costs never surprise me.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given the monthly cap is reached, when anyone asks the assistant, then it refuses politely and the refusal is logged.

User story: As an owner, I want the assistant limited to each user's permissions and to drafts, so that AI cannot leak data or approve money.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a user without access to a project, when they ask about it, then every tool returns a permission error.
2. Given any conversation, when the assistant is asked to approve, send, sign or pay, then it can only create drafts.

User story: As an owner, I want a check that every number the AI states comes from a tool, so that no invented prices reach anyone.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given an answer containing a total that no tool returned, when the guardrail runs, then the answer is flagged and the user warned.

User story: As an owner, I want to use Claude or ChatGPT with my data through an MCP connector, so that I work from the AI tools I already use.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given an MCP client configured with an engineer's API key, when it calls a read-only tool for their project, then data is returned; for another engineer's project it is denied.

User story: As an owner, I want the platform live on my domain over HTTPS, so that clients can use it from anywhere.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given the hosting chosen and DNS on Cloudflare, when the stack is deployed, then https://<domain>/app, /portal and the public pages work in Arabic.

User story: As an owner, I want encrypted daily backups outside the server and a tested restore, so that I never lose client data.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given the daily job ran, when I restore the latest backup on another machine using only docs/restore.md, then the site works and the time taken is recorded.
2. Given a backup fails, when the job ends, then I receive an email.

User story: As an owner, I want one-command deploys with automatic rollback, so that updates are safe.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a release tag that fails its health check, when deploy.sh runs, then the previous version is restored automatically.

User story: As an owner, I want private files never cached publicly, so that client photos stay private.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a private file URL, when it is requested through Cloudflare, then the response is never a cache HIT.

User story: As a client, I want to sign in with Google or Facebook on the live site, so that I do not need another password.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given my registered email, when I sign in with Google or Facebook, then I reach my portal.
2. Given an unknown Google account, when it signs in, then access is refused and no account is created.

User story: As an owner, I want data-protection obligations settled before launch, so that the business complies with Egypt's PDPL.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given the checklist in phase 19, when launch is prepared, then licence, data location, DPO, notices, breach plan and data register each have a recorded answer.

User story: As an owner, I want uptime and disk alerts, so that I know about problems before clients do.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given the site is down for 5 minutes or the disk passes 80%, when monitoring checks, then I receive an email.

User story: As an owner, I want live integrations switched on one at a time and tested, so that nothing breaks at launch.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given gateway, push, AI and GPS are configured, when each is switched on, then its live test passes and is recorded before the next one.

User story: As a platform owner, I want to create a new office as its own site in minutes, so that I can sell the product to other offices.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given the provisioning screen with office name, admin email and subdomain, when I create a tenant, then a new site with the apps, defaults and branding is live at office.<domain>.

User story: As a platform owner, I want plans by feature flags and limits with monthly billing, so that I earn recurring revenue.
Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a tenant on a plan without online payments, when its admin opens settings, then online payments cannot be switched on.
2. Given an unpaid invoice past grace, when the billing job runs, then the tenant is suspended with a notice.

User story: As a platform owner, I want updates rolled out to all tenants safely, so that one bad release does not hit everyone.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given a new release, when I roll it out, then canary tenants migrate first and the rest follow only if they pass.

User story: As a prospective office owner, I want to sign up for a trial and be guided in Arabic, so that I can start without a sales call.
Acceptance criteria: 1. Given the signup page, when I register and finish the wizard, then my office has a logo, a first template and a first project.
